killedBy: steps.mjs: removing the AudioContext constructor before boot removes both spellings the audio stack looks for
why: Removes one spelling and leaves the other. Howler reads `AudioContext` and falls back to `webkitAudioContext`, so a half-removal still hands it a constructor to block in and the capture keeps the full stall this override exists to avoid -- while the page looks correct, because the app's own `ensureCtx` reads the same pair and would take the null path either way.
